Spain Wildfire Claims Lives Amidst Extreme Heat Wave

A devastating wildfire in Spain's Almeria region has resulted in multiple fatalities, with reports indicating at least 12 deaths and 23 people missing. The blaze, exacerbated by an extreme heat wave, has overwhelmed firefighters and turned roads into dangerous traps for victims. Efforts are underway to contain the fire, described as one of Spain's deadliest.
